footer.privacyContent:
# Privacy Policy

**Last updated:** April 19, 2026

BitcoinStart Nordics respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect personal information when you visit our website, contact us, download resources, or book a session.

## 1. Who we are

**Business name:** BitcoinStart Nordics  
**Location:** Norway  
**Email:** info@bitcoinstart.no  
**Website:** https://bitcoinstart.no

For privacy-related questions, you can contact us at: **info@bitcoinstart.no**

## 2. What personal data we collect

We may collect the following information:

- Name
- Email address
- Company name, if provided
- Information you submit through contact or booking forms
- Information you provide when downloading a guide or resource
- Basic technical information such as browser type, device type, and IP address
- Analytics or cookie-related data, if enabled on the website

We only collect personal data that is relevant to operating the website, responding to inquiries, providing services, and improving the user experience.

## 3. How we collect your data

We collect personal data when you:

- fill out a contact form
- submit a booking request
- download a free guide or resource
- contact us by email
- browse our website
- interact with cookies or analytics tools, where applicable

## 4. Why we use your data

We may use your personal data to:

- respond to inquiries
- process booking requests
- provide requested services
- send requested resources
- improve the website and user experience
- communicate with you about your request or session
- maintain website security and prevent misuse
- comply with legal obligations

## 5. Legal basis for processing

Depending on the situation, we process personal data based on one or more of the following legal grounds:

- your consent
- taking steps at your request before entering into a service agreement
- our legitimate interests in operating and improving our business and website
- compliance with legal obligations

## 6. Cookies and analytics

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies.

If we use non-essential cookies, such as analytics or marketing cookies, we will request your consent before using them where required by applicable law.

Essential cookies that are necessary for the website to function may be used without prior consent.

If you use our website, you may also be able to manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings or through a cookie banner, where available.

## 7. How long we keep your data

We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required by law.

As a general guideline:

- contact form submissions: up to 12 months
- booking inquiries: up to 24 months
- client-related communication: as long as needed for service delivery and follow-up
- legal or accounting records: as required by applicable law

If you ask us to delete your data, we will assess and respond in accordance with applicable data protection law.

## 8. Sharing of personal data

We do not sell your personal data.

We may share data with trusted service providers only where necessary to operate the website or provide services, for example:

- website hosting providers
- form or email service providers
- booking tools
- analytics providers
- professional advisors where needed

These third parties may process data on our behalf and only to the extent necessary for the relevant service.

## 9. International transfers

Some of our service providers may process personal data outside Norway or the EEA.

Where this happens, we aim to ensure that appropriate safeguards are in place, such as standard contractual clauses or other lawful transfer mechanisms where required.

## 10. Data security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration.

However, no method of transmission over the internet or method of electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## 11. Your rights

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have the right to:

- request access to your personal data
- request correction of inaccurate data
- request deletion of your data
- request restriction of processing
- object to certain processing
- withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
- request data portability
- lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

If you are in Norway, you may contact the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet).

## 12. Third-party links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those websites.

## 13. Children

Our website and services are not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

## 14. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any updates will be posted on this page with a revised "Last updated" date.

## 15. Contact

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we process personal data, contact us at:

**BitcoinStart Nordics**  
**Email:** info@bitcoinstart.no  
**Website:** https://bitcoinstart.no
